caption: The drawing depicts a circular plate or medallion with a decorative floral motif inside. The central object is a stylized vase or pot, predominantly cream-colored with brown and reddish accents, featuring a symmetrical, curving design and leaf-like patterns. From the vase, several long, arched stems rise, each ending in large, detailed flowers or flower-like shapes; two of these flowers are outlined in brown with dotted petals, while others, including two on either side, have reddish and brown hues with curled, elongated petals. Smaller, similarly styled flowers and leafy elements are interspersed around the main flowers. The background of the circle shows a mottled wash of green, yellow, tan, and soft red-brown, while the edge of the medallion is bordered by a brown line. The entire composition is rendered on a beige or off-white background, and there is a small, neat signature in brown ink placed outside the lower right of the circle.
title: Pa. German Plate
